name: westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_request_active_list_mode
description: WestwoodOnlineUpgradeDialog::RequestActiveListMode asks the WOL provider to request the current active list mode with requests enabled.
known_limits: Tier C only; no VC COFF byte-comparison target exists yet, so tier S remains open.
functional_evidence: Binary Ninja assembly for 0x43e680 validates loading g_pWestwoodOnlineUpgradeApi, reading g_WestwoodOnlineUpgradeActiveListMode, pushing enabled value 1, and dispatching WOL provider RequestListMode through vtable offset 0x18.
Native smoke westwood_online_upgrade_dialog_request_active_list_mode_smoke installs the fake WOL API and verifies one RequestListMode call with the active list mode and enabled value 1.
